metaDescription: Komondor vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Komondor boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan Komondor social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader Komondor exposure.
Weight range 80-130 lb (36-59 kg) and grooming needs (Corded coat is a specialist skill.) belong in the same Komondor household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.
If your Komondor is also monitored for entropin, ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed Komondor appointments.
After the Komondor puppy/kitten series, keep adult DA2PP / DHPP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Owners postpone Komondor shots when the puppy seems “a little off,” travel intervenes, or hip dysplasia worries dominate the week — ask the clinic whether a same-week Komondor make-up is still appropriate instead of sliding to the annual exam.
Long gaps can leave Komondor antibody levels uncertain, so expect either an added booster or a titer conversation rather than a shrug.
Do not trade the missed Komondor dose for extra socialization; finish immunity first for this giant dog.
Reset the Komondor reminder stack the evening of the make-up appointment — including the eventual adult booster after the 16-week finish.

faqs.question: When does the Komondor core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Komondor misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Komondor health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Komondor adult health guide for breed predispositions such as hip dysplasia, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
